subject: Overnight ops playbook + rooming escalation plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@havenhotels.com>, Prime Travel Desk <traveldesk@primecorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Craig Miller <craig.miller@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Overnight ops playbook + rooming escalation plan

Hi team — kicking off the rooming and on-site escalation plan for next month's Acme executive workshop. I attached the initial rooming spreadsheet (rooming_list_v1.xlsx) and a special needs capture form for any accessibility / dietary / equipment requests. Key asks below so we can lock the block and run logistics: 

1) Block & cut-off: hold 28 rooms (18 king standard, 6 double queen, 4 suites) Sep 28 cut-off. Please confirm the cut-off date and if we can extend for late registrants.
2) Master bill and billing code: we need a per-night master bill with a single PO billing code — PO will come from Acme (Bill to: Acme Corp, PO: ACME-WORKSHOP-10). Can you confirm invoice cadence?
3) Late arrivals / early departures: any guest arriving past midnight needs an express check-in flow; include late-arrival keycode instructions and on-call front desk contact.
4) Accessibility & preference tags: mark rooms for mobility needs, fragrance-free, and AV racks for two breakout rooms. I'll send special_needs_form.pdf separately for individuals.
5) Escalation matrix: include primary ops contact (Emily), fallback ops (on-site GM) and a Redwood escalation contact (we'll use Laura on evenings).

Please reply with: confirmed cut-off date, master bill steps, shuttle window options, and whether suite upgrades can be held aside for VIPs (we have one VP + one external exec who may request).

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Events & Programs
Redwood Inference
attachments: rooming_list_v1.xlsx, special_needs_form.pdf

From: Emily Ross <emily.ross@havenhotels.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Prime Travel Desk <traveldesk@primecorp.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Overnight ops playbook + rooming escalation plan

Hi Marissa — thanks for the detailed brief and the attachments. Quick confirmations below: 

- Cut-off: we can set the cut-off for bookings at Sep 30, 2026. After that date rates are subject to availability but we'll hold a small waitlist.
- Master bill: we can run a master bill to Acme Corp with monthly invoices; we'll need a signed master billing form (I attached block_confirmation.pdf) and the PO at time of final bill.
- Late arrivals: front desk can do express check-in; we'll provide an arrival key drop for guests arriving after 11:30pm and an on-call number for overnight desk staff.
- Suite holds: we can tentatively reserve 2 suites for VIPs. To guarantee upgrades we require confirmation 14 days prior; otherwise we'll release them to inventory.
- Accessibility tagging: we can add mobility/fragrance-free tags in our PMS, please include individual needs in special_needs_form.pdf.

Two operational notes: 
1) Peak arrival window is 3–6pm on the first night; we recommend staggered arrivals or dedicated check-in table for Redwood.
2) Catering: if you need room service on call for late arrivals, we can provide a limited menu after 10pm (fee applies).

Emily Ross
Conference Services Manager
Haven Hotels
attachments: block_confirmation.pdf

From: Prime Travel Desk <traveldesk@primecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Emily Ross <emily.ross@havenhotels.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Overnight ops playbook + rooming escalation plan

Marissa — Prime Travel here. We can operate two shuttle windows for arrival: 2:30pm and 4:30pm, each with capacity for 18 passengers (coach vans). We'll coordinate pick-up from SFO hourly if needed. For VIPs we can request private car service (estimate attached in line item). Also confirming that we can waive early check-in fees for up to 4 VIPs with front desk approval if rooms are available.

Please send final headcount by Oct 15 so we can lock shuttle manifests.

– Travel Desk (Prime)
traveldesk@primecorp.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Ross <emily.ross@havenhotels.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Overnight ops playbook + rooming escalation plan

Thanks Marissa — two pragmatic asks from Redwood leadership: 

1) Please hold 1 additional executive suite for our VP (name to be confirmed) and mark it as 'upgrade hold'. We'll confirm by Oct 24.
2) Emergency contact: if there's a property-level incident outside business hours, loop me (laura.bennett@redwood.ai) and copy Tessa. Laura mobile: +1 (415) 555-0199.

Short and sweet — appreciate the coordination.

– Laura

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@havenhotels.com>, Prime Travel Desk <traveldesk@primecorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Craig Miller <craig.miller@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Overnight ops playbook + rooming escalation plan

Perfect — thank you, Emily and Travel Desk. Recap / next steps so nothing slips: 

A) Cut-off & holds: Hotel confirms Sep 30 cut-off, Haven will hold 28 rooms and 2 suites (one suite is an upgrade hold) until Oct 14 for final confirmation.
B) Master bill & PO: Emily to send the block confirmation (received). Acme will provide PO by Oct 20; Emily to confirm invoice cadence once PO is received.
C) Headcount & manifests: I'll deliver final headcount + rooming manifest by Oct 15 (rooming_list_v1.xlsx -> final version). Prime Travel will finalize shuttle manifests on Oct 16.
D) Accessibility & preferences: I'll collect any special needs via special_needs_form.pdf and provide a spreadsheet column with tags for PMS. Laura will be the after-hours escalation contact; Tessa will manage onsite logistics (welcome table, signage, AV liaison).
E) Late arrivals: Emily to provide keydrop instructions and overnight desk number. Travel Desk will supply shuttle schedule and VIP car quotes.

Open items for Emily: 1) confirm whether we can get one complimentary meeting room for pre-registration on day 0 (evening before) and 2) confirm the fee for late-night catering after 10pm.

Thanks all — I'm attaching the current rooming_list_v1.xlsx again for visibility and will push updates as I receive them.

Marissa
attachments: rooming_list_v1.xlsx

From: Emily Ross <emily.ross@havenhotels.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Prime Travel Desk <traveldesk@primecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Overnight ops playbook + rooming escalation plan

Thanks Marissa — all noted. Quick answers: 

• Complimentary meeting room: we can provide one pre-registration foyer space (up to 2 hours) on the evening before at no charge; full meeting room is available at a reduced rate — I'll send a short quote.
• Late-night catering: limited menu flat fee of $180 per service (server + set-up) after 10pm.

I've updated our PMS with the tags you requested and attached the final_rooming_manifest.pdf (includes preliminary room assignments and arrival windows). We'll hold the upgrade suite until Oct 14 as requested.

Emily Ross
Conference Services Manager
Haven Hotels
attachments: final_rooming_manifest.pdf
